'''International relations'''
*[[French military withdrawal from West Africa (2022–present)|French military withdrawal from West Africa]]
**[[France–Ivory Coast relations]]
***In his [[New Year]]'s speech, [[President of Ivory Coast|Ivorian President]] [[Alassane Ouattara]] announces that the [[France|French]] military base in [[Abidjan]] will be handed over to the [[Government of Ivory Coast|Ivorian Government]] in January. [https://www.france24.com/fr/afrique/20241231-la-base-de-l-arm%C3%A9e-fran%C3%A7aise-%C3%A0-abidjan-sera-r%C3%A9troc%C3%A9d%C3%A9e-%C3%A0-la-c%C3%B4te-d-ivoire-en-janvier (France 24)]
**[[France–Senegal relations]]
***In his New Year's speech, [[President of Senegal|Senegalese President]] [[Bassirou Diomaye Faye]] announces the closure of French military facilities and the withdrawal of all foreign military forces from [[Senegal]] beginning in 2025. [https://www.lefigaro.fr/flash-actu/le-senegal-annonce-la-fin-de-toutes-presences-militaires-etrangeres-des-2025-20241231 (''Le Figaro'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2024 Ecuadorian conflict]]
**An [[Ecuador]]ian judge issues [[arrest warrant]]s for 16 [[Ecuadorian Army|soldiers]] accused of the disappearance and [[Crime in Ecuador|murder]] of four children in [[Guayaquil]] after [[genetic test]]s confirm the charred remains found near a military base belong to the missing victims. [https://apnews.com/article/ecuador-violence-missing-children-military-charged-cb6c5eacce2c92cdb085bf8ea97b5c43 (AP)]
*[[2024 South Korean martial law crisis]]
**The [[Judiciary of South Korea|Seoul Western District Court]] issues an arrest warrant for impeached [[President of South Korea|president]] [[Yoon Suk Yeol]]. [https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2024/12/31/asia-pacific/politics/south-korea-yoon-arrest-warrant/ (''The Japan Times'')]
*[[Belgrade school shooting]]
**A [[Judiciary of Serbia|Serbian court]] sentences the parents of a boy who killed 10 people in a [[Belgrade]] primary school in 2023 to over 14 years and three years in prison, respectively, for [[child neglect]] and [[Child abuse|abuse]], and also sentences a [[shooting range]] instructor to 1 and a half years for [[perjury]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/serbian-court-sentences-parents-boy-mass-shooter-2024-12-30/ (Reuters)]
*[[Capital punishment in Zimbabwe]]
**[[Zimbabwe]] approves a law abolishing the [[death penalty]] in the country, effective immediately. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cn8gqz7n559o (BBC News)]
*[[Kivu conflict]], [[Capital punishment in the Democratic Republic of the Congo]]
**A [[military tribunal]] in [[North Kivu]], [[Democratic Republic of Congo]], sentences 13 [[Armed Forces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo|soldiers]] [[death penalty|to death]] for charges including [[murder]], [[looting]], and [[cowardice#military law|cowardice]], following territorial losses attributed to [[desertion]] during the conflict. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/congo-sentences-13-soldiers-death-bid-boost-discipline-2025-01-01/ (Reuters)]
*Five people are wounded during a [[mass stabbing]] amid [[New Year's Eve]] celebrations in [[Verucchio]], [[Province of Rimini]], [[Italy]]. The perpetrator is shot dead by a soldier. The perpetrator was carrying a Koran and an Islamic prayer cap, while also possessing antipsychotic drugs at his residence. [https://www.ilrestodelcarlino.it/rimini/cronaca/terrore-coltello-carabinieri-sparano-uccidono-jb1zyqh2 (''Il Resto del Carlino'')]
*A man steals an [[excavator]] in [[Grünsfeld]], [[Baden-Württemberg]], [[Germany]], and rams the excavator against vehicles, injuring four [[Baden-Württemberg Police|police officers]], before being shot dead. [https://www.dw.com/en/police-shoot-dead-man-on-suspected-rampage-with-excavator/a-71191556 (DW)]
